_not: Gerçek Bluesky paylaşımları (27 Kasım 2026, Katar GP; public.api.bsky.app getAuthorFeed). Rory Mitchell metinleri ve zamanları özgün ve tam. Medland F2 notu: yalnız ilk 12 kelime alınabildi (devamı bilinmiyor, eklenmedi).
mitchell: No updates listed for Red Bull, McLaren, Mercedes or Ferrari for the #QatarGP. Only Audi has brought a minor update to their front brake deflectors. #F1

Antonelli is quickest in FP1 for the #QatarGP with a 1:23.217s set early in the session on the medium tyre. Russell on the soft tyres is 0.5s off in P2, with Hadjar 0.6s off in P3. 

Quite a lot of time for McLaren and Ferrari to find early on, with them 0.8s and 1.2s off the pace respectively. #F1

Front tyre deg a big factor as the session progressed, with pretty much all the drivers complaining about understeer. Verstappen even remarked that he wanted an additional "10 clicks" of front wing. #F1 #QatarGP
First weekend in F2 for current F3 champion, Ugo Ugochukwu, and he's taken pole for the Qatar Feature Race. #F1 #QatarGP

Vowles said he didn't know that Williams' restructure costs were included in F1's cost cap, and that it was done because the company structure remained unchanged since 1977.

"You can see it in our company's house report. It's a 50-year-old company, so it wasn't fit for purpose." #F1 #QatarGP
Odd moment for Leclerc during the start of FP2 as he lost control of his Ferrari exiting T5 and spun off into the gravel after passing the Racing Bulls of Lawson. #F1 #QatarGP
Red flag halfway through FP2. Lots of gravel on track from various offs throughout the session. #F1 #QatarGP
Red flag again! Gasly is off at T10 and beached it into the gravel. #F1 #QatarGP
Gasly lost it on the gravel exiting the corner, then takes out the 100m marker board for good measure. Will be another car with floor damage. #F1 #QatarGP
Race Control has extended the session by 13 minutes because of the two red flags. #F1 #QatarGP
Near miss between Hamilton and Verstappen at Turn 1. Verstappen team radio: "You see that? My god." #F1 #QatarGP
Hamilton has stopped on track at T2 with three minutes left in FP2. Team radio: "Something's happened. I've lost power." #F1 #QatarGP

Antonelli tops Friday with another fastest time in FP2. This time he did a 1:23.077 on mediums, with Russell closer in P2 (+0.127s) on the medium and Norris P3 on the soft tyres (+0.445s). #F1 #QatarGP

The FIA International Court of Appeal dismissed Audi's appeal regarding the Italian Grand Prix. Audi had contested the decision not to penalize Yuki Tsunoda for causing an additional formation lap and not starting from the pit lane. #F1 #QatarGP
